settings.title: Settings
settings.openNews: Settings: something new in the error log
settings.motionHint: Stops animations that play by themselves.
settings.stepsOpen: Show the steps between answers unfolded
settings.stepsHint: The thinking and the tool calls between two answers fold into one line, such as “Thought for 2m 38s”.
settings.botHomeHint: An employee started without a working folder gets a new folder of its own in here, named after it and made a git repository. An employee that has one keeps it.
settings.staffWhat: What a new employee starts with (“Default”: Claude Code's own settings). The launch dialog's Advanced settings can change any of it for one start; an employee going back to work starts as it last did.
staff.openHint: Each one's folder, model, effort and permission mode in one list: change them for one or several at once, import a list of new ones, export it.
staff.title: All employees
staff.what: What each employee starts with when it goes back to work (“Start work”): the folder, the model, the thinking effort, the permission mode and whether it hears who else is in the office. One never started from the page goes by the settings until it is. A change takes effect at its next start; names stay as they are.
staff.find: Find an employee by name or folder
staff.none: No employees yet: import a list, or hire one.
staff.noneSelected: Select employees to change them together.
staff.deleteConfirm: Delete {names}? Their seats are freed; their folders and their work stay.
staff.importWhat: Paste a list or choose a file: a name on each line, or the JSON that Export gives (its fields: name, dir, model, effort, permissionMode, context). A name that's an employee's changes what it starts with (a field left out stays as it is); any other is a new employee, which goes by the settings for what its entry leaves out. At most {max} at a time; nothing changes until you press Import.
staff.fileTooBig: {file} is too big for a list of employees (over 1 MB).
staff.badJSON: This isn't JSON that can be read: {reason}
staff.noList: The JSON holds no list of employees (an array, or one under "employees").
staff.badItem: not a name, nor an object with a name
staff.oneName: the whole line is the name (a name on each line; JSON says more)
staff.unknownField: “{field}” isn't read and is left out
staff.exported: Your browser saved {file} with {n} employees, usually in your downloads. Import reads it back.
errlog.title: Report a problem
errlog.what: Errors are written to the error log by themselves as they happen. To report a problem, take the report file below and send it to us by email, or attach it to an issue on GitHub. It holds the errors, the versions and the bridge’s last log lines, but no key, token or conversation.
errlog.clearConfirm: Clear the error log? What it keeps now is gone for good.
errlog.inLog: Recorded in the error log. To report it: Settings → Report a problem.
error.fault_bad_request: the error report needs a known kind and a text
error.fault_too_many: the pages reported too many errors in the last minute; the rest are dropped
errlog.report: I want to report a problem
errlog.saved: Your browser saved {file}, usually in your downloads. Send it to us by email, or attach it to an issue on GitHub.
